in_hebrew.name: נומי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'nun' (נון) meaning 'to comfort, to console,' or 'to please,' and 'mem' (מים) meaning 'water,' this name means 'pleasance, delight,' or 'pleasantness.'

in_greek.name: Νομίς
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'nomos' (νόμος) meaning 'law,' or 'custom,' this name means 'habit,' or 'custom.'
